project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to manage student data and course selections, likely within an educational platform. The file structure suggests a component-based architecture, with dedicated views for various stages of the student experience – from initial course selection to result viewing. The presence of components like ‘ApplicationServices’ and ‘spLayout’ indicates a potential for a service-oriented architecture alongside a standardized layout. Overall, the application leverages Vue.js for a dynamic user interface.

layers.description: Individual Vue components responsible for rendering specific UI elements.
Components and logic managing application navigation and route transitions.

macro_trends.title: Prop Drilling Concerns
macro_trends.description: Multiple Vue files (e.g., ‘viewRequestStatus’, ‘StudentSearchComponent’) heavily rely on prop drilling, potentially leading to performance degradation and code complexity. This is a common symptom of a lack of a centralized state management solution.

macro_trends.title: Potential for Centralized Fragility
macro_trends.description: The presence of files like 'ApplicationServices.vue' and 'SelectedApplicationService.vue' hints at potential centralized logic, which could become a single point of failure or a bottleneck for scaling.  A microservices approach may be beneficial here.

key_workflows.name: Student Course Selection Flow
key_workflows.description: The initial flow involves selecting courses (e.g., through ‘iLikeCourses’, ‘iLikeCoursesNew’), submitting exam forms (via ‘ExamFormSubmission’), and potentially managing fees (through ‘FeeDetails’).  This workflow demonstrates a basic but key component to the application's functionality.

key_workflows.name: Result Retrieval Workflow
key_workflows.description: This involves retrieving student results from the system after completing examinations, visualized within components like 'ResultPage' and 'viewRequestStatus'.  The dependency on prop drilling highlights a potential area for optimization.
